subject: Draft MAP: SOC2 evidence & security review — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>
To: Claire Rhodes <claire.rhodes@firstbridge.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: SOC2 evidence & security review — next steps and owners

Hi Claire — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) slice so we can align on owners and dates for the security/SOC2 milestone. Attached: MAP_FirstBridge_v0.2.pdf and the SOC2 questionnaire you requested (SOC2_Questionnaire_FirstBridge.xlsx).

Summary (high level)
- Goal: Deliver a complete SOC 2 evidence package to FirstBridge compliance so you can complete your vendor review. Target handoff: 2026-05-11.
- Shortlist of MAP milestones (proposed):
  1) Security questionnaire answers — draft to FirstBridge (owner: Jasmine) — due 2026-04-27
  2) Evidence collection (logs/configs/access lists) — owner: Marissa (Redwood SRE lead) with Sergio providing technical artifacts — due 2026-05-04
  3) Internal security review with FirstBridge (walkthrough) — target meeting 2026-05-06
  4) Final SOC2 package delivery (zip + evidence index) — owner: Jasmine/Marissa — due 2026-05-11

Dependencies we noted on the call:
- Procurement needs vendor attestation and the evidence index format (Procurement contact: procure@firstbridge.com).
- FirstBridge will confirm whether an external Auditor needs direct access to logs or whether submitted artifacts are sufficient.

Immediate next steps (action items)
- Claire: confirm procurement contact and whether an auditor will need direct access (due 2026-04-22)
- Jasmine: populate questionnaire draft and share by 2026-04-27 (attached xlsx).
- Sergio: gather technical artifacts list and sample log extracts; will send a short checklist by 2026-04-23.
- Marissa: collect access-control screenshots and configuration exports; target 2026-05-04.

If the dates above look tight we can shift the handoff window by a week; I wanted to propose aggressive targets so we can hit your Q2 compliance window if possible. Let me know any blockers and I will adjust the MAP and push to the Drive link.

Thanks — Jasmine
--
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments:
- MAP_FirstBridge_v0.2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
- SOC2_Questionnaire_FirstBridge.xlsx (Excel)

From: Claire Rhodes <claire.rhodes@firstbridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@firstbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: SOC2 evidence & security review — next steps and owners

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear MAP. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Procurement is looped (Procurement <procure@firstbridge.com>) and will weigh in on attestation language. They typically require a statement on log retention and access controls.
- We do expect the external auditor to request either direct read-only access to logs or a signed attestation + exported evidence set; I'll confirm which by 2026-04-23.
- Could you also share a 1-page SOC2 summary (what controls are in-scope, period covered) we can hand to the auditor ahead of the review?

On dates: your proposed timeline looks reasonable but please flag anything marked as "ready for auditor" earlier if possible.

Claire

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Claire Rhodes <claire.rhodes@firstbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: SOC2 evidence & security review — next steps and owners

Claire, Jasmine — quick technical note on evidence and two pragmatic delivery options so procurement/audit can choose: 

Option A (recommended for speed):
- Redwood compiles an evidence bundle (exported logs, config snapshots, IAM lists, access logs) with a signed evidence index and hash manifest.
- Delivery: secure Drive link + signed index.
- Pros: fast, no auditor access required.
- Cons: auditor may request additional context or raw ingestion.

Option B (auditor access):
- Provide temporary read-only access (timeboxed) for auditor to our log export endpoint.
- Pros: full fidelity for auditor.
- Cons: requires procurement/legal approval and an interim access playbook.

Notes on artifacts:
- Sample log extracts: we can deliver a 24-hour slice for your audit team (anonymized) and a mapping table explaining event types.
- Evidence locations: S3 buckets and snapshot exports (I will include exact object paths in the checklist).

Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — 1-page control scope + period (2025-10 through 2026-03).

I will assemble the technical checklist and checklist of exact artifacts by 2026-04-23 (as proposed). If Procurement prefers Option B, flag now so we can start the access approvals.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Claire Rhodes <claire.rhodes@firstbridge.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: SOC2 evidence & security review — next steps and owners

Claire / team — looping in from a delivery & approvals perspective.

Thanks for the outline — I approve an accelerated MAP for FirstBridge given the Q2 dependency. A couple of asks and clarifications from our side:

1) Risk / blocker: if Procurement requires direct auditor access (Option B), that will add legal steps (agreements, IP redaction) and could push the final handoff by 10–14 days. Please flag as soon as you have clarity.

2) DocuSign / procurement flow: if you confirm the contract path, share the DocuSign link or PO format so our finance team can prioritize.

3) Proposed meeting: security walkthrough with FirstBridge on 2026-05-06 at 10:00 AM PT — please confirm.

4) Owner confirmations: Jasmine will shepherd questionnaire and communications; Marissa will own evidence packaging; Sergio will provide artifact manifests and signed hash lists.

If Procurement confirms that a signed evidence bundle is sufficient we will commit to the 2026-05-11 handoff. If auditor access is needed, we will propose a revised MAP and new handoff date.

Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
--
Attachments referenced elsewhere: MAP_FirstBridge_v0.2.pdf, SOC2_Questionnaire_FirstBridge.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
